title: Payment requests returning HTTP 500 after v2.8.1 deploy
symptoms: Alert `PaymentServiceDBPoolSaturated` fired at 17:10 UTC. Requests needing the database failed with HTTP 500 after waiting 3s for a pooled connection. Peak error rate 31.2%, p99 latency 17,064 ms (SLO 1200 ms), 139,807 failed requests. Customers could not complete card payments; checkout conversion dropped sharply. Most recent change to payment-service: DEP-0296 (v2.8.1) deployed at 2026-06-16 13:40 UTC.
root_cause: Regression introduced by payment-service v2.8.1 (DEP-0296): the release changed how database connections are pooled and pods ran out of connections under load. Details in the linked pull request.
resolution: Rolled back payment-service to v2.8.0 (DEP-0297) at 17:50 UTC; metrics recovered by 18:03 UTC. Permanent fix PR-1504 ("Restore configurable DB pool size (revert hard-coded pool_size)") shipped in DEP-0308 (v2.8.2). Responders followed RB-0049 (Payment API 500 Errors).

title: API Gateway latency spike and timeouts on GET /v1/{service}/{path}
symptoms: Alert `ApiGatewayUpstreamErrorRate` fired at 17:14 UTC. Calls from api-gateway to payment-service started failing at 17:11 UTC. Peak error rate 26.9%, p99 latency 3,471 ms (SLO 450 ms), 16,962 failed requests. Client traffic through the public API was affected across all features.
root_cause: Downstream impact of INC-0406 in payment-service (Payment requests returning HTTP 500 after v2.8.1 deploy). api-gateway has a hard dependency on payment-service (routes /v1/payments/*).
resolution: No change needed in api-gateway; errors stopped when INC-0406 was mitigated at 18:03 UTC. Responders followed RB-0053 (API Gateway Timeout).

title: order-service p99 latency far above SLO
symptoms: Alert `OrderServiceUpstreamErrorRate` fired at 17:13 UTC. Calls from order-service to payment-service started failing at 17:12 UTC. Peak error rate 27.1%, p99 latency 6,328 ms (SLO 800 ms), 11,214 failed requests. Checkouts failed and orders were not created.
root_cause: Downstream impact of INC-0406 in payment-service (Payment requests returning HTTP 500 after v2.8.1 deploy). order-service has a hard dependency on payment-service (authorises and captures payments).
resolution: No change needed in order-service; errors stopped when INC-0406 was mitigated at 18:03 UTC.
